name: strawverse-root
description: StrawVerse - Download anime & manga in batches, unified across Desktop & Android

scripts.start:desktop: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm start
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:gui && cd capacitor && npm run sync:android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd capacitor/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
